### Implementation details

- **Core Mechanic:** Drag/flick upwards to launch seed pellets. The seeds fly "into" the wall (simulated with dynamic scaling) and attach when they reach the peak of their arc, provided they don't hit the rolling shade bands.
- **Active Play & Escalation:** The "Sunlight" bar continuously drains, forcing you to keep planting to survive. Over time, the camera scroll speed increases, sunlight drains faster, and the rolling shadow slabs spawn more frequently to narrow your usable space.
- **Aesthetics & Vibe:** Adheres strictly to the "matte planter panels and pastel afternoon light" aesthetic with no purple in sight. Supports seamless switching between light and dark modes with a Swiss modern UI approach.
- **Juice & Polish:** Uses the Web Audio API for stutter-house inspired pluck synth sounds (dynamically climbing a pentatonic scale) when planting successfully, screen shake and guarded haptic feedback (`navigator.vibrate`) on hits/misses, and floating text for points.
- **Mobile First:** Uses proper pointer event handling and CSS `touch-action: none` / `overscroll-behavior: none` to prevent scroll hijacking on mobile browsers.

The game is fully self-contained in a single, highly-optimized HTML file well under the size limits. Open it up in a browser and try it out!

- **Concept**: Two-lane runner riding the seam between dream-pop fog (left, coral) and laser melodic-techno river (right, mint). Tap left/right halves to switch lanes; be in the open side when gates arrive.
- **Loop**: Tap every 1-2s to swap. Score = 10 × combo (capped ×5). Combo accumulates per clean clear, resets on hit.
- **Escalation**: Speed ramps from 240→540 px/s, spawn interval tightens 1.0s→0.5s, lane spread narrows 22%→16%, approach window collapses 1.7s→0.7s.
- **Win/lose**: 60s clean = "CLEAN MIX". Hit a closed gate = "BLEED" with shake + crash sfx.
- **Audio**: Continuous pad chord panned hard-left (Am add9, sine + LFO filter), 124 BPM techno kick + sawtooth arp + hat panned hard-right. Volume crossfades with player lane so you literally hear which side you're on. Switch/clear/hit/win sfx via Web Audio.
- **Polish**: easeInOut lane lerp (90ms), trail dots, particle bursts + "+20" floaters on clear, screen shake + color flash on hit, looming wall gradient when gate is close, scan-line on grid side, drifting fog clouds + sparkle dust on fog side, soft seam glow when player crosses center, vignettes for HUD legibility.
- **Controls**: tap left/right halves, A/D, ←/→, H/L. Vibrate on switch/clear/hit/win.
